components.purpose: The invisible skeleton of every Aura screen: it sets the 16px screen gutter, the 20px gap between sections and the tighter 8–12px gaps inside a group. Almost every visible grouping in the home screen is a Stack around leaves.
whenToUse: Wrapping the whole screen body in a vertical Stack with padding 400 and gap 500 (the section rhythm seen between hero card, search, chips, activity)
Pairing a caption over a title, e.g. 'Good morning' + 'Hi, Layla' with gap 100
Laying the three translucent quick actions of the balance card side by side with direction horizontal, gap 300
Section header rows: direction horizontal, justify between, align center ('Recent activity' / 'See all')
whenNotToUse: When the group needs a visible white rounded container with shadow — use Card, which owns radius.xl and shadow.sm
When the group is a run of tappable rows with hairlines — use a Card wrapping ListItem, not a Stack of Texts
For the pinned tab bar — use BottomNav in the footer region
anatomy: direction axis (vertical by default)
gap — space.* token between children
padding — space.* token, 400 at screen level
align / justify for cross- and main-axis
optional background (surface / raised / brand-subtle) + radius when a Stack is used as a soft tinted panel

variants.name: direction=vertical, gap=500
variants.usage: Screen body rhythm: hero → search → chips → section → CTA

variants.name: direction=vertical, gap=100
variants.usage: Label-over-value pairs (greeting, 'Total balance' over the amount)

variants.name: direction=horizontal, gap=300
variants.usage: Quick-action rows inside the gradient balance card; chip-like button rows

variants.name: direction=horizontal, justify=between, align=center
variants.usage: Section header with a trailing tertiary link

variants.name: background=brand-subtle, radius=md
variants.usage: The 40×40 violet tile behind a transaction glyph or an active nav icon

components.content: Stack carries no copy. Do not fake spacing with empty Text nodes.
components.placement: Outermost body wrapper uses padding 400 (16px = layout.gutter). Nested Stacks inside a Card use padding 0 and let the Card's padding do the work.
components.states: Stateless. Never attach press behaviour to a Stack — promote the row to ListItem or Button.
dos: Use gap tokens exclusively; the observed ladder is 100 / 200 / 300 / 500
Keep one vertical Stack as the single body scroller so section gaps stay 20px
Use background=surface for the muted #EDEAF4 inputs/segment tracks
donts: Don't nest more than three Stacks deep — the screen flattens into Card + rows
Don't use gap 800 between sections; 500 is the system's section-gap
Don't put padding on both a Stack and the Card it wraps

components.purpose: All typography in Aura Wallet is Plus Jakarta Sans. Hierarchy is carried by weight (800 display/titles vs 400 body) and tight negative letter-spacing, not by colour.
whenToUse: Balance figures at style=display (33/40, -1px) on the gradient card
Screen and section titles at title-lg ('Hi, Layla') and title ('Recent activity')
Transaction names at body-strong, meta lines ('Today · Coffee') at body with tone secondary
'See all' at label with tone link
whenNotToUse: For a tappable label — use Button variant=tertiary so it gets a 44px target
For a status pill like 'Pending' — use Tag
For a label/value receipt line — use SummaryRow, which aligns the value to the end
anatomy: single type token (type.display → type.caption-strong)
tone role from text.* (primary #171021, secondary #6E6880, link #7C22D6, success #007D46, error #D52634, inverse #FFFFFF)
optional maxLines with ellipsis
align (start by default; center only inside EmptyState or a centered sheet)

variants.name: display
variants.usage: One per screen: the balance amount. Always on a gradient/inverse surface, tone inverse

variants.name: title-lg
variants.usage: Greeting / screen title in the scroll area, where there is no TopBar

variants.name: title
variants.usage: Section headers above a Card group

variants.name: headline
variants.usage: Card titles and sheet titles

variants.name: body-strong
variants.usage: Row titles and amounts; the signed amount in a transaction row

variants.name: body
variants.usage: Default paragraph and row subtitles (pair with tone secondary)

variants.name: label
variants.usage: Inline links, chip and button labels, nav labels

variants.name: caption / caption-strong
variants.usage: Eyebrows like 'Good morning', timestamps, tiny metadata

components.content: Sentence case everywhere — 'Total balance', 'Recent activity', 'Pay a bill'. No ALL CAPS eyebrows. Currency is written as 'AED 12,480.50' with the code first, thousands separators, two decimals for balances; signed amounts prefix an en-dash or plus: '−AED 24.00', '+AED 9,200'. Use '·' as the meta separator.
components.placement: Eyebrow sits 4px above its title (gap 100). Section titles sit 20px below the previous block and 12px above their Card.
components.states: Static. Truncate names with maxLines 1; never truncate a monetary value.
dos: Reserve tone success for credits and tone error for failures — not for debits, which stay text.primary
Let weight 800 + tight tracking do the emphasis on numbers
Use tone secondary for every second line in a row
donts: Don't colour a debit red; in this product only incoming money is coloured
Don't use display for anything that isn't a currency figure
Don't set body copy in violet — violet text is reserved for links

components.purpose: 56px screen header for pushed screens (transaction detail, Send flow, settings). The home screen deliberately has none — it opens straight into the greeting — so the TopBar is the marker that you are one level deep.
whenToUse: Any screen reached from Home that needs a back affordance
Flow screens (Top up, Send, Swap) where the trailing slot holds 'help' or 'close'
Brand variant on confirmation/receipt screens that continue the violet surface
whenNotToUse: On tab-root screens — use the GreetingHeader pattern (caption + title-lg + Avatar) instead
When the header must scroll away with content — put a Text title-lg in the body
anatomy: 56px bar on bg.canvas with no border and no shadow
leading 24px icon (back / close / menu) in icon.primary
centred or leading title at type.headline
optional trailing icon at 24px, icon.primary (icon.inverse on brand variant)

variants.name: default
variants.usage: Fill bg.canvas #F4F2F8 so the bar melts into the lilac page; title in text.primary

variants.name: brand
variants.usage: Fill bg.brand-strong #6A21C8, white title and icons — for money-movement flows that sit on violet

components.content: Title ≤24 chars, sentence case, noun phrase: 'Transaction', 'Send money', 'Card settings'.
components.placement: Header region only, flush to the top, full bleed. Body starts immediately after with padding 400.
components.states: Icons get a ghost 44×44 target; pressed shows an 8% ink overlay. No elevation on scroll — the canvas and the surface share a family, so keep shadow.none.
dos: Keep leading=back as the default and close only for modal flows
Match variant=brand to a brand-coloured body region so the seam is invisible
donts: Don't add a shadow or hairline under the default bar
Don't put the account avatar in the trailing slot on deep screens — it belongs to the home greeting

components.purpose: Sunken search field for finding transactions. It reads as a recess in the page — muted #EDEAF4 fill with an inset shadow — which is the opposite of the raised white cards below it.
whenToUse: Directly under the balance hero on Home to search transactions
Top of any long list: all activity, beneficiaries, merchants
whenNotToUse: When the user must type a value you will submit — use TextField, which has a label and helper/error
When you only need to narrow a short list by category — use ChipGroup
anatomy: 44px tall pill-ish container at radius.lg 16px
fill bg.surface #EDEAF4 with shadow.inset and a 1px border.default
leading search icon 20px in icon.secondary
placeholder at type.body in text.tertiary, 12px after the icon

variants.name: default
variants.usage: The only variant; width is always full gutter-to-gutter

components.content: Placeholder names the corpus, sentence case, no ellipsis: 'Search transactions', 'Search merchants'.
components.placement: Full width inside the body Stack, 20px below the hero card and 20px above the filter chips. Never inside a Card.
components.states: Focus adds shadow.focus (3px violet 35%) and switches the border to border.focus. Typing swaps the trailing area for a clear ✕ in icon.secondary.
dos: Always pair with the ChipGroup underneath — search and filters are one unit in this product
Keep the inset shadow; it is what separates the field from the canvas
donts: Don't put the search bar on white — it needs the lilac canvas around it to read as sunken
Don't add a 'Search' button; filtering is live

components.purpose: The commitment control. Note for implementers: in Aura Wallet primary is **Violet 700 (#6A21C8) with a white label** — not the green described in the generic catalog. One primary button per screen, pinned above the tab bar.
whenToUse: The single screen action pinned in the footer: 'Pay a bill', 'Send AED 250', 'Confirm top up'
Translucent quick actions inside the gradient balance card (Top up / Send / Swap) at size md
Inline tertiary links such as 'See all' next to a section title
whenNotToUse: Icon-only affordances — use IconButton (44×44, accessible label required)
Choosing between mutually exclusive filters — use ChipGroup or SegmentedControl
A whole tappable row with title + subtitle — use ListItem with trailing chevron
anatomy: radius.lg 16px (not a full pill) — corners are soft rectangles like every other Aura surface
heights 56 / 44 / 36 for lg / md / sm; padding-x 24 / 20 / 16
optional 20px leading icon with 8px gap
label at type.label (weight 600); 17px-ish optical weight at size lg
shadow.md under the primary fill, which gives it the same lift as the hero card

variants.name: primary
variants.usage: Fill bg.brand-strong #6A21C8, white label, shadow.md. Exactly one per screen, fullWidth, in the footer

variants.name: secondary
variants.usage: White fill, 1.5px border.default, ink label — the paired 'Cancel'/'Not now' or actions sitting on canvas

variants.name: tertiary
variants.usage: No fill, violet #7C22D6 label — 'See all', 'Skip', 'Add note'. Size sm or md only

variants.name: danger
variants.usage: Fill feedback.error #DC2F3A, white label — 'Block card', 'Delete beneficiary', only after a confirmation sheet

components.content: Verb-first and specific, sentence case, ≤24 chars: 'Pay a bill', 'Top up', 'Send', 'Swap'. Put the amount in the label when it reduces doubt ('Send AED 250'). No trailing punctuation, no 'Click'.
components.placement: Primary lives in the footer region, fullWidth, 16px side margins, 12px (layout.footer-gap) above the BottomNav. Quick actions live in a horizontal Stack inside the hero card with gap 300 and equal widths.
components.states: Pressed: fill darkens ~8% and shadow drops to sm. Disabled: fill at 38% opacity, no shadow, label keeps white. Loading: label replaced by a spinner, width held. Focus: shadow.focus ring.
dos: Keep the footer CTA fullWidth so it reads as a shelf above the nav
Use the translucent #FFFFFF2E treatment for buttons sitting on the gradient card
Match tertiary buttons to text.link so links and buttons agree
donts: Don't stack two primaries; demote the second to secondary or tertiary
Don't use radius.pill — Aura buttons are 16px-cornered rectangles
Don't put a danger button in the footer of a normal task screen

components.purpose: A 44×44 square-cornered (radius.lg) icon target for compact actions: notifications, scan-to-pay, card freeze, sheet close. It borrows the white-with-1.5px-border language of secondary Button.
whenToUse: Trailing utility next to the greeting (bell, qr-code) on Home
Closing a BottomSheet
Toolbar of a card detail screen: freeze, settings, share
whenNotToUse: When the action needs to be discoverable by name — use Button with an icon
For the account entry point on Home — use Avatar with initials, as observed
For tab navigation — use BottomNav
anatomy: 44×44 box, radius.lg 16px
24px glyph centred, icon.primary (white on brand variant)
outline: white fill + 1.5px border.default; brand: #6A21C8 fill
required accessible label, never rendered

variants.name: outline
variants.usage: Default on canvas — white square with a hairline, matching secondary Button

variants.name: brand
variants.usage: Violet filled square for the one emphasised utility, e.g. 'Scan to pay'

variants.name: ghost
variants.usage: No fill/border — inside TopBars, sheets and card headers where a box would add noise

components.content: Accessible label is a verb phrase: 'Open notifications', 'Scan QR to pay'.
components.placement: End of a header row, 12px from its neighbour; groups of icon buttons use gap 200. Never below the fold as the main action.
components.states: Pressed: 8% ink overlay (brand: 8% white). Disabled: 38% opacity. Badged: 8px feedback.error dot at the top-right, 2px canvas ring.
dos: Always keep the full 44px target even when the glyph is 20px
Use no more than two icon buttons in a header
donts: Don't make icon buttons circular — squares with 16px radius are the Aura silhouette
Don't use brand variant twice on one screen

components.purpose: Labelled input for money-movement flows (amount, IBAN, reference, card nickname). Shares the sunken #EDEAF4 recess of SearchBar so all inputs read as one family.
whenToUse: Send / Top up / Swap forms
Adding a beneficiary or editing profile details
Entering a promo or reference code
whenNotToUse: Filtering an existing list — use SearchBar
Picking one of a few options — use SegmentedControl or ChipGroup
Displaying a computed value — use SummaryRow
anatomy: label above the field at type.label, text.secondary, 8px gap
44px field at radius.lg, fill bg.surface, 1px border.default, shadow.inset
optional 20px leading icon in icon.secondary, 12px gap
value at type.body text.primary; placeholder at text.tertiary
helper or error line below at type.caption (text.secondary / text.error), 4px gap

variants.name: default
variants.usage: Standard single-line entry

variants.name: with icon
variants.usage: Semantic prefix: banknote for amount, user for beneficiary, credit-card for card number

variants.name: error
variants.usage: 2px border.error + caption in text.error; used after submit or on blur, never while typing

components.content: Labels are short nouns in sentence case: 'Amount', 'Recipient IBAN'. Helper explains limits ('Daily limit AED 20,000 remaining'). Errors state the fix: 'Enter an amount of at least AED 5'.
components.placement: Stacked vertically with gap 400 inside a body Stack with padding 400. Amount fields in money flows may render their value at type.display above a smaller field.
components.states: Focus: border.focus + shadow.focus, inset shadow retained. Filled: text.primary. Disabled: fill bg.canvas, text.tertiary, no shadow. Error: border-width.strong in border.error.
dos: Always show a label — placeholders alone are not used in this system
Show only one of helper or error at a time
donts: Don't use white fills for inputs; inputs are recesses, cards are raised
Don't validate on every keystroke for currency fields

components.purpose: The activity filter rail — All / Income / Spending / Bills. Selection inverts to near-black ink (#1C1130), not violet, which keeps the violet reserved for the balance and the CTA.
whenToUse: Filtering the transaction list under the search bar
Quick date ranges on Insights: This week / Month / Year
Category narrowing inside a full 'All activity' screen
whenNotToUse: Two or three exclusive views of the same data — use SegmentedControl (a shared track reads as a switch, chips read as filters)
Navigating to another screen — use ListItem or BottomNav
Displaying a non-interactive status — use Tag
anatomy: horizontal scrolling rail, 8px gap, first chip flush to the 16px gutter
chip: 36px tall, radius.lg 16px, padding-x 16px
unselected: white fill, 1.5px border.default, label text.primary at type.label
selected: fill bg.inverse #1C1130, label white, no border

variants.name: selected=0 ('All')
variants.usage: Default state of every filter rail; 'All' is always the first chip

variants.name: selected=-1
variants.usage: No filter applied — only when the rail is additive rather than exclusive

components.content: One or two words, sentence case, ≤18 chars: 'All', 'Income', 'Spending', 'Bills'. Max 6 chips; put the most used first.
components.placement: Directly below SearchBar with 20px gap, above the section title. Edge-to-edge scroll: bleed past the right gutter, but keep 16px leading inset.
components.states: Selected = inverse ink fill. Pressed = 8% ink overlay on the border/fill. Disabled = 38% opacity. Counts may be appended in the label ('Bills 3').
dos: Keep exactly one chip selected at a time in this pattern
Let the rail scroll horizontally rather than wrapping to two lines
donts: Don't colour the selected chip violet — that clashes with the hero and CTA
Don't exceed 6 chips; move the rest behind a 'filter' IconButton

components.purpose: Small 24px status or promo label for row-level metadata: 'Pending', 'Refund', 'Bill due', 'Plus'. It states, it never acts.
whenToUse: Marking a transaction as Pending or Failed inside a ListItem
Flagging a subscription or recurring bill
Badging a card as Virtual / Frozen
whenNotToUse: Filtering — use ChipGroup (chips are 36px and tappable)
Full-width messaging — use InlineAlert
Counts on a service tile — use the ServiceGrid tile badge
anatomy: 24px pill-ish box at radius.sm 8px, padding-x 8px
label at type.caption-strong (12/16, +0.1 tracking)
subtle tonal fill with a matching darker label; no border

variants.name: brand
variants.usage: bg.brand-subtle + text.link — Aura-owned labels like 'Instant'

variants.name: plus
variants.usage: Gradient-adjacent premium marker for the paid tier

variants.name: success
variants.usage: feedback.success-subtle + text.success — 'Received', 'Settled'

variants.name: warning
variants.usage: feedback.warning-subtle + text.warning — 'Pending', 'Due soon'

variants.name: error
variants.usage: feedback.error-subtle + text.error — 'Failed', 'Declined'

variants.name: info
variants.usage: feedback.info-subtle + text.info — 'Scheduled'

variants.name: neutral
variants.usage: bg.surface + text.secondary — low-salience metadata

components.content: One word where possible, sentence case, ≤16 chars. Never a sentence, never a verb.
components.placement: Inline after a row title with 8px gap, or in the trailing slot above the amount. Only one tag per row.
components.states: Static and non-interactive.
dos: Match tone to the semantic colour used elsewhere on the screen
Keep tags out of the gradient card — they lose contrast
donts: Don't use a tag as a button
Don't stack multiple tags on one transaction row

components.purpose: The raised white block with 24px corners and a soft shadow that holds every group of content in Aura. On Home there are two: the gradient balance hero and the white activity list.
whenToUse: Wrapping a run of ListItems so the group floats off the lilac canvas
The balance hero (tone brand-strong with the brand gradient)
Grouping SummaryRows in a receipt, or a card-detail block
whenNotToUse: Single full-width messages — use InlineAlert
Promotional cross-sell with a CTA — use PromoBanner
Invisible grouping that only needs spacing — use Stack
anatomy: radius.xl 24px
tone fill: white (raised) / #EDEAF4 (surface) / violet-subtle / gradient (brand-strong) / #1C1130 (inverse)
shadow.sm on raised; brand-strong adds shadow.md plus the radial brand-glow beneath
internal gap space.300 between children
padding 300 for row lists (rows bring their own 16px), 400–500 for content cards

variants.name: raised
variants.usage: Default: white #FFFFFF, shadow.sm. Activity lists, detail blocks, receipts

variants.name: surface
variants.usage: Flat #EDEAF4 with a 1px hairline and no shadow — secondary information that shouldn't compete

variants.name: brand-subtle
variants.usage: #EDE6FB tint for informational or upsell blocks that stay quiet

variants.name: brand-strong
variants.usage: The gradient hero. Reserved for balance and money-movement summaries; max one per screen

variants.name: inverse
variants.usage: #1C1130 ink card for a virtual card face or a dark stat block

components.content: Optional title at type.headline, sentence case, ≤32 chars. Card titles are nouns; keep the verb in the CTA.
components.placement: Full width between the 16px gutters, 20px from the block above. Cards never sit inside cards.
components.states: Whole-card press (when it navigates) shows an 8% ink overlay and shadow dropping to none. Otherwise static; interactivity lives in the rows.
dos: Use padding 300 when children are ListItems so the row's own inset defines the rhythm
Keep the gradient hero to a single instance per screen
donts: Don't nest a Card in a Card — switch the inner group to a Stack with background=surface
Don't put a border on the raised card; its border-width is 0 and elevation comes from shadow.sm
Don't use radius.lg — cards are 24px, buttons are 16px

components.purpose: The transaction row — and by extension every row in the app. Leading 40px violet-subtle tile, title + meta line, trailing value or chevron, hairline between siblings.
whenToUse: Transactions inside the activity Card (merchant, 'Today · Coffee', signed amount)
Settings and profile rows with trailing chevron or toggle
Beneficiaries and cards lists, using avatar initials as the leading element
whenNotToUse: Pure label/value with no leading element and no navigation — use SummaryRow
A tappable tile grid of services — use ServiceGrid
A promotional row with a CTA — use PromoBanner
anatomy: leading 40×40 tile at radius.md 12px, fill bg.brand-subtle, glyph/emoji centred — or a 40px Avatar with initials
title at type.body-strong, text.primary, 1 line
subtitle at type.body, text.secondary, format 'When · Category'
trailing: amount at type.body-strong (text.primary for debits, text.success for credits), or a 20px chevron in icon.secondary, or a toggle
1px border.subtle divider inset to the text column, never under the last row

variants.name: trailing=text
variants.usage: Money rows: signed amount right-aligned, '−AED 24.00' / '+AED 9,200'

variants.name: trailing=chevron
variants.usage: Navigational rows: transaction detail, settings

variants.name: trailing=toggle
variants.usage: Preference rows: notifications, card lock

variants.name: avatar
variants.usage: People and beneficiaries — two-letter initials replace the tile glyph

variants.name: trailing=none
variants.usage: Read-only history entries inside a detail screen

components.content: Title is the merchant or person exactly as billed, ≤40 chars, truncate with ellipsis. Subtitle is relative time then category, separated by '·': 'Today · Coffee', 'Yesterday · Income', 'Mon · Transport'.
components.placement: Stacked inside a Card with padding 300; row height ~72px with 16px horizontal inset. Dividers between rows only.
components.states: Pressed: full-row 6% ink wash, corners respected at the card edges. Pending rows dim the amount to text.secondary and add a warning Tag. Disabled rows drop to 38% opacity.
dos: Keep one consistent leading treatment per list (all tiles or all avatars)
Right-align amounts on a shared optical column so digits line up
Colour only credits (text.success); debits stay ink
donts: Don't let the subtitle wrap to two lines
Don't put both a tag and a chevron and an amount in the trailing area
Don't draw a divider after the final row

components.purpose: A 3- or 4-up grid of violet-tiled shortcuts for the money services Aura offers beyond the balance card: bills, transfers, cards, rewards, exchange, splits.
whenToUse: A 'Pay & transfer' hub screen or an expanded home section below the balance card
Surfacing 6–8 destinations that would be too long as a list
whenNotToUse: Fewer than four destinations — use ListItem rows, which carry subtitles
Actions on the balance itself (Top up / Send / Swap) — those live as translucent buttons inside the hero card
A single promoted service — use PromoBanner
anatomy: tile: 40px icon container at radius.md, fill bg.brand-subtle, glyph icon.brand 24px
label under the icon at type.caption, text.primary, centred, max 12 chars
optional badge pill at the tile's top-right using caption-strong on feedback.error
grid gap: 16px column, 20px row

variants.name: columns=4
variants.usage: Default home shortcut strip, up to 8 tiles in two rows

variants.name: columns=3
variants.usage: Hub screens where labels are longer ('Exchange', 'Split bill')

components.content: Single-word labels where possible: 'Bills', 'Transfer', 'Cards', 'Rewards', 'Exchange', 'Split'. Badges are numeric or 'New'.
components.placement: Inside a raised Card with padding 400, or directly on canvas between hero and activity. 20px above and below.
components.states: Tile press scales the icon container to 0.96 and deepens the tint to violet 200. Unavailable services render at 38% opacity with no badge.
dos: Keep every tile glyph in icon.brand on bg.brand-subtle for one consistent violet family
Fill the last row or reduce the count — no orphan single tile
donts: Don't mix multi-coloured tile fills; Aura's shortcuts are monochrome violet
Don't exceed 8 tiles — move overflow behind a 'More' tile

components.purpose: Full-width 24px-radius promotional block in a vertical colour, with a translucent-white CTA. It is the only element allowed to introduce a non-violet hue to the page.
whenToUse: Cross-sell below the activity list: cashback, a new card product, referral
Seasonal offers on an Insights or Rewards screen
whenNotToUse: System status or a blocking message — use InlineAlert
The balance hero — that is a Card tone=brand-strong with the brand gradient
Small metadata — use Tag
anatomy: 24px radius container, padding 24px, internal gap 12px, shadow.md
title at type.title on the fill's title colour
subtitle at type.body ≤56 chars
CTA pill on a #FFFFFF2E wash (or solid violet on light fills)
decorative art circle at #FFFFFF1F with a white 24px glyph on the trailing edge

variants.name: brand
variants.usage: The violet→magenta gradient. Reserve for Aura's own flagship offers — do not use on the same screen as the balance hero

variants.name: go
variants.usage: Violet #7C22D6 flat — transfers and instant-payment promos

variants.name: get
variants.usage: Magenta #E5218D — rewards, cashback, referrals

variants.name: eat
variants.usage: Cream #FFE9B8 with ink text and a solid violet CTA — lifestyle and merchant offers

variants.name: pay
variants.usage: Deep indigo #1E1B4B with a violet CTA — cards, credit and premium tiers

components.content: Title is the benefit, ≤32 chars: 'Get 5% back on bills'. Subtitle qualifies it in one clause. CTA is 2–3 words: 'Activate', 'See offers'.
components.placement: Full width between gutters, 20px below the preceding section. One banner per screen; never directly adjacent to the gradient hero.
components.states: Pressed: 8% black overlay across the fill. Dismissible banners get a ghost close IconButton in the top-right.
dos: Pick the tone by product area so colour stays meaningful
Keep body copy to one line on a 390px width
donts: Don't stack two banners
Don't use tone=brand when a gradient balance card is already on screen — two gradients cancel each other out

components.purpose: Shows where money is in flight: a bar with an ETA for transfers being processed, or a vertical timeline of a transaction's lifecycle on the detail screen.
whenToUse: 'Arriving by 14:30' on an outgoing international transfer
Timeline of Initiated → Processing → Sent → Received on a transaction detail
Multi-step onboarding or KYC progress
whenNotToUse: A finished, single-state outcome — use InlineAlert tone=success or a Tag
A list of past events with amounts — use ListItem rows
anatomy: bar: 4px track in border.subtle with a violet #7C22D6 fill, title above at type.headline
timeline: 20px dots connected by a 2px rail; completed dots filled violet with a white check, current dot ringed with shadow.focus, future dots border.strong
step labels at type.body (current at body-strong), timestamps at type.caption text.secondary

variants.name: bar
variants.usage: Compact in-flight status with an ETA title, inside a raised Card at the top of a screen

variants.name: timeline
variants.usage: Transaction detail: full ordered history with times

components.content: Title states the outcome and time: 'Arrives in 12 min', 'Arriving by 14:30'. Steps are past-tense or noun states ≤22 chars: 'Initiated', 'Processing', 'Received'.
components.placement: Inside a Card padding 400, directly under the header or the amount. 20px from neighbours.
components.states: Current step is violet and bold; completed steps are violet with reduced-weight labels; failed steps switch the dot and label to feedback.error.
dos: Always pair a bar with a human ETA title
Keep steps to a maximum of 5
donts: Don't animate indefinitely without an ETA or state label
Don't use the timeline for anything without a guaranteed order

components.purpose: Rarely used in a wallet: a stylised map for merchant locations, ATM/top-up points and the location context on a card transaction.
whenToUse: 'Where was this spent?' block on a transaction detail
Finding nearby cash-in agents or partner ATMs
whenNotToUse: Any non-geographic media — use MediaPlaceholder
Progress of a transfer — use ProgressTracker
anatomy: rounded container at radius.md, tinted with bg.sky #E6EEFC
route/street lines in border.default; violet map-pin marker
optional pin label and ETA chip on a white pill with shadow.sm

variants.name: inset (default)
variants.usage: Inside a Card at 160–200px height, corners radius.md

variants.name: fullBleed
variants.usage: Edge-to-edge under the TopBar on a dedicated 'Find cash points' screen

language.name: Luminous Violet Fintech
language.summary: Aura Wallet sits on a pale lilac canvas (#F4F2F8) that is never pure white, so every white card floats with a soft, low-contrast shadow. One saturated violet→magenta gradient carries the money — the balance hero — and everything else is quiet: ink-black numerals, grey-violet meta text, and violet-subtle tiles for iconography. Type is Plus Jakarta Sans with heavy 800 weights and tight negative tracking on numbers, which makes balances feel engineered rather than decorative. Corners are generous and consistent: 24px on cards and sheets, 16px on buttons, inputs and chips, 12px on the little tiles — nothing is a circle, nothing is a sharp rectangle.

principles.title: One gradient per screen
principles.body: The violet→magenta gradient is the money itself. Give it to the balance hero and nothing else; a second gradient halves the impact of both.

principles.title: Raised versus recessed
principles.body: Content that holds value is raised (white, shadow.sm, 24px radius). Controls you type into are recessed (#EDEAF4, inset shadow). The page reads at a glance because of that one opposition.

principles.title: Colour carries meaning, not decoration
principles.body: Violet means brand, action and selection-by-tile. Green means money coming in. Ink means everything else — debits are never red.

principles.title: Numbers lead
principles.body: Every screen resolves to a figure. Set it at the heaviest weight available, tight-tracked, with the currency code first, and give it more space than any label around it.

principles.title: Separate with space, not lines
principles.body: The only hairlines in the product are between rows inside a card and above the tab bar. Sections are separated by a 20px gap on lilac.

language.color: Roughly 70% pale lilac canvas and white cards, 20% ink and grey-violet text, 10% saturated colour. The violet appears in exactly four places: the gradient balance hero (#7A18D8 → #A81FBE → #E5218D at 115°, with a radial magenta glow bleeding below it), the primary CTA fill (#6A21C8), links and the active tab (#7C22D6), and the #EDE6FB subtle tiles behind icons and avatars. Selection in chips inverts to near-black #1C1130 rather than violet, so filters never fight the CTA. Semantic colour is used sparingly: only credits get green (#007D46); debits stay ink #171021. Sub-brand fills (go violet, get magenta, eat cream, pay indigo) exist for promo banners only.
language.typography: Plus Jakarta Sans throughout (IBM Plex Sans Arabic for RTL). Two registers: a display register at weight 800 with negative tracking (display 33/40 at -1px for balances, title-lg 24 for the greeting, title 20 for section headers) and a UI register at 400/600/700 (body 16, label 15 semibold for buttons and chips, caption 12 for eyebrows and tab labels). Hierarchy is driven by weight and size, never by colour or caps. Everything is sentence case; eyebrows like 'Good morning' are caption-weight, not uppercase.
language.shape: A ladder of soft rectangles: 24px cards, sheets and banners; 16px buttons, inputs, chips and icon buttons; 12px media tiles, avatars and nav-active tiles; 8px tags. Nothing is fully circular — even the account avatar is a squircle. Pills are avoided so that the CTA and the chips share the same corner family as the cards.
language.depth: Elevation is soft, violet-tinted and layered in three steps: shadow.sm on white cards (barely there, 2px/8px), shadow.md under the primary button and the gradient hero (10px/28px), and a radial brand-glow that leaks magenta light onto the canvas beneath the balance card. Inputs move the other direction with a 1px inset shadow. Borders are used only where there is no shadow: 1.5px on secondary buttons and unselected chips, 1px hairlines between rows and above the tab bar.
language.density: Regular-to-airy. 16px gutters, 20px between sections, 12px inside groups, 72px transaction rows. Numbers and titles get breathing room; the screen shows about three blocks above the fold (greeting, hero, filters) and never more than two competing surfaces at once.
language.iconography: Rounded, 2px-stroke line icons at 20px in rows and 24px in navigation, coloured icon.secondary when passive and icon.brand when active. Icons almost always sit inside a 40px #EDE6FB rounded square rather than floating free — that violet tile is the product's most repeated shape, appearing as transaction glyph, avatar, service tile and the active tab indicator. Merchant categories may be represented by emoji inside the same tile.
language.imagery: Minimal photography. Image slots are violet-tinted 12px placeholders; brand expression comes from gradient and light, not pictures. Decorative art on banners is a translucent white circle behind an outlined glyph.
language.voice: Warm and personal at the top of the screen ('Good morning', 'Hi, Layla'), then terse and factual everywhere money is involved ('Total balance', 'Today · Coffee', '−AED 24.00'). Actions are verb-first and short: 'Top up', 'Send', 'Swap', 'Pay a bill'. No exclamation marks, no finance jargon, no 'Dear customer'.
dos: Open tab-root screens with a greeting header and no TopBar
Right-align every monetary value on a shared column
Wrap every run of rows in a white 24px-radius card with inset hairlines
Use the violet-subtle tile for every icon, avatar and active-tab indicator
Pin exactly one full-width primary button above the tab bar
donts: Don't put the gradient on more than one surface per screen
Don't colour debits red or use green for anything but incoming money
Don't use pill-shaped buttons or circular avatars
Don't place white cards on white — the lilac canvas is what makes elevation read
Don't introduce a second typeface or uppercase labels

layout.summary: Screens are a single vertical scroll on lilac canvas with 16px gutters, built from three or four full-width blocks separated by 20px: an identity/greeting header, one hero value surface, a filter zone (search + chips), and a card of rows. Actions are pinned: one full-width primary button 12px above a white 4-tab bar. There is no TopBar on tab roots — the greeting is the header — and pushed screens swap the greeting for a 56px TopBar on the same canvas colour.
layout.grid: Single column, full-bleed background with 16px (layout.gutter) side margins for all content. Cards and buttons span gutter to gutter. Horizontal rails (ChipGroup) keep the 16px leading inset and bleed past the right edge. Inside cards, rows inset their text column by 52px (40px tile + 12px gap) and dividers align to that column.
layout.rhythm: 20px (layout.section-gap) between blocks; 12px between a section title and its card; 12px between siblings inside a card; 8px between a label and its control; 4px between an eyebrow and its title. 72px transaction rows. 12px (layout.footer-gap) between the pinned CTA and the BottomNav; 24px between the last body block and the footer shelf.
layout.navigation: Persistent 4-item BottomNav (Home, Cards, Insights, Profile) on every tab root, active tab shown as a violet glyph over a violet-subtle tile. Drill-downs push a screen with a default TopBar (leading=back). Money flows (Top up, Send, Swap, Pay a bill) hide the BottomNav, use a TopBar with leading=close, and confirm in a BottomSheet whose CTA repeats the amount. Filtering never navigates: search and chips re-render the list in place.
layout.hierarchy: 1) Who you are and the time of day (greeting + avatar). 2) How much you have (gradient hero with display figure and three quick actions). 3) How to narrow what follows (search, then chips). 4) What happened (section title with 'See all', then a card of rows). 5) What to do next (pinned primary button). 6) Where else to go (tab bar).

rules: Exactly one gradient surface (Card tone=brand-strong or PromoBanner tone=brand) per screen — on Home it is always the balance hero.
Exactly one primary Button per screen, fullWidth, in the footer, 12px above the BottomNav.
Tab roots have no TopBar; they start with a caption eyebrow + title-lg greeting and a trailing Avatar. Pushed screens always have a TopBar and no greeting.
Runs of two or more rows must be wrapped in a Card (padding 300) with inset dividers between rows and none after the last.
SearchBar and ChipGroup always appear together, in that order, with the ChipGroup's first chip being 'All' and selected by default.
Section titles use style=title with an optional tertiary Button ('See all') in a horizontal Stack, justify=between, align=center.
Monetary values are right-aligned at body-strong; credits use tone=success with a '+', debits stay tone=primary with '−'.
Never nest a Card inside a Card; switch the inner grouping to a Stack with background=surface.
Body content stays within 16px gutters; only MapPlaceholder and BottomNav may be full bleed.
Hide the BottomNav inside money flows and behind BottomSheets; show it on every tab root.
Use a 20px gap between sections and never a Divider — hairlines exist only inside cards and above the tab bar.
Maximum four distinct surfaces per screen (canvas + hero + card + footer shelf); anything more should move to a new screen.

20px gap
ChipGroup: 36px chips, radius 16, white with 1.5px border; selected chip filled #1C1130 with white label
'All' is always first and is the default selection

variants.name: search + chips
variants.usage: Default, as observed on Home

variants.name: chips only
variants.usage: Short lists where typing adds nothing

variants.name: search + chips + filter button
variants.usage: Long histories: a trailing outline IconButton with icon=filter opens a BottomSheet of advanced filters

guide.content: Placeholder names the corpus ('Search transactions'). Chips are single nouns: All, Income, Spending, Bills.
guide.placement: Between the balance hero and the first section title, 20px above and below. In pushed list screens it pins under the TopBar.
guide.states: Selected chip is inverse ink. An active search shows a clear ✕; combined search + chip filtering yields an in-card EmptyState when nothing matches.
dos: Keep exactly one chip selected
Persist the chip selection when the user returns from a detail screen
donts: Don't wrap chips onto a second line
Don't colour the selected chip violet — that belongs to the CTA and the active tab

patterns.name: SectionHeaderRow
patterns.purpose: A section title paired with a violet text link that opens the full list.

guide.purpose: Introduces a card of rows: a weight-800 title on the left and a violet tertiary action on the right, both on the lilac canvas outside the card.
whenToUse: Above the recent activity Card on Home
Above any truncated list that has a fuller screen behind it
Above a ServiceGrid block ('Pay & transfer' / 'Edit')
whenNotToUse: Inside a Card — use the Card's own title prop at type.headline
When there is nothing to link to — use a plain Text at style=title
anatomy: horizontal Stack, justify=between, align=center, 16px gutters
title at type.title, text.primary
trailing tertiary Button at type.label in text.link #7C22D6, ≤12 chars, with a 44px target

variants.name: with link
variants.usage: Truncated lists — 'Recent activity' / 'See all'

variants.name: title only
variants.usage: Terminal sections with no deeper screen

variants.name: with count
variants.usage: Append a neutral Tag after the title when the number matters ('Bills' + '3 due')

guide.content: Title is a two-word noun phrase in sentence case: 'Recent activity', 'Upcoming bills'. Link is 'See all' — not 'View more' or 'More →'.
guide.placement: 20px below the preceding block, 12px above its Card.
guide.states: Link press dims to violet 800; disabled when the full list is empty.
dos: Keep the link as a tertiary Button, not a bare Text, so it is reachable
Align the title's baseline with the link's
donts: Don't add an icon to the 'See all' link
Don't place the header inside the card it introduces

patterns.name: ActivityCard
patterns.purpose: A white 24px-radius card holding the last few transactions as tiled rows with signed, right-aligned amounts.

guide.purpose: The standard money-history block: two to five transaction rows inside a raised white card, each with a violet-subtle glyph tile, a 'When · Category' meta line, and an amount coloured only when money came in.
whenToUse: Recent activity on Home (3 rows, then 'See all')
Per-day groups in the full activity screen
Card-specific transactions on the Cards tab
whenNotToUse: Fee and total breakdowns — use a Card of SummaryRows
A single highlighted transaction — use the transaction detail template
Navigational settings rows — same ListItem, but no signed amounts
anatomy: Card tone=raised, padding 300, radius 24, shadow.sm
ListItem rows: 40px violet-subtle tile (glyph or merchant emoji) → title body-strong → subtitle 'Today · Coffee' in text.secondary → trailing amount body-strong
1px border.subtle dividers between rows, inset to the text column, none after the last
optional trailing Tag on pending rows

variants.name: preview (3 rows)
variants.usage: Home, always paired with a SectionHeaderRow carrying 'See all'

variants.name: grouped by day
variants.usage: Full activity screen: a caption-strong date label above each card

variants.name: empty
variants.usage: Card contains a compact EmptyState when a filter returns nothing; the FilterRail stays above it

guide.content: Row title is the merchant as billed. Subtitle is relative time then category with a '·'. Amounts: '−AED 24.00' for debits in ink, '+AED 9,200' for credits in text.success.
guide.placement: Directly under its SectionHeaderRow with a 12px gap, full width between 16px gutters, 24px above the footer shelf.
guide.states: Row press wash at 6% ink; pending rows dim the amount and add a warning Tag; failed rows strike no text but show an error Tag.
dos: Cap the Home preview at three rows
Keep all amounts on one right-aligned column
Use the same leading treatment for every row in a card
donts: Don't colour debits red
Don't add a divider after the final row
Don't mix avatars and category tiles in one card
